correctness.rationale: The coordinate construction is exact. The original family on l2 is Parseval. Choosing the one-vector local frame {sqrt(i)} gives S_i=iI, so the transformed coefficient on e_i is divided by i and the transformed energy is sum_i |<f,e_i>|^2/i^2. Evaluating at e_n gives 1/n^2, excluding any positive lower frame bound. Conversely, uniform sup_i||S_i|| and sup_i||S_i^{-1}|| give the stated two-sided bounds by applying the singular-value inequalities coordinatewise.
residual_risks: The source notation for the local transformed analysis operator contains a j-index ambiguity; the singleton-J_i counterexample removes that ambiguity.
